33. PW 3 Mr Nozrul Islam deposed in support of the Plaintiffs' case, however, in cross he admitted that the land of Shachida Nanda Sarkar was vested property earlier and leased out to the leasees for 5 years. The plaintiffs' resides in Debiganj, then said that they reside in the house of Shachida Nanda Sarkar and Nurul Islam alone reside in Debiganj. He could not say the plot and khatian number of the suit land. He further admitted that Government's Godown of Debiganj is situated on the Government land, all the side land of Godown are land of Shachida Nanda Sarkar. There are many houses in the land of Shachida Nanda Sarkar which is adjacent to Government's Godown, there is a Graveyard in the land of Shachida Nanda Sarkar. 

 34. In view of the testimonies of PW Nos.1- 3, we have perused the exchange deed being Deed No.3260 of the year 1960 which has been submitted by the respondent No.10(i) as additional evidence dated 12-4-2022. On perusal of the title deed, we find that the submission advanced by the learned Advocate Mr Zulfiqur Ahmed on behalf of the respondent No.10(i), the instant deed not in the name of the Khandakar Nurul Isalm and between the Shachida Nanda Sarkar, rather, from the recital of the aforesaid deed, it transpires that deed was executed by Sree Dherendra Chandra Ghosh, son of Showrandra Chandra Ghosh of village: Jalpaiguri town, Thana and District: Jalpaiguri and purchaser was Romesh Chandra Bhowmic, son of Sree Robini Kanto Bhowmic of village: Jalpaiguri town, P.S. and District: Jalpaiguri. From the schedule it also transpires that land has described from the Collectorate of Jalpaiguri including the land of settlement Jarip No.1/770 in Khatian No.1 measuring 614 decimals of land and another land bearing settlement jarip and Hal Khatian No.1355 and Dag No.565/13 measuring 13 decimals of land which is quite different land from the land of the present suit. The aforesaid deed is not a deed of exchange; rather, it is out and out sale deed.
